ClimateLaunchpad is a free space to explore, test, and shape your concept with expert guidance. Learn Learn by doing Gain practical tools to shape your idea into a real solution. Join boot camps, coaching sessions, and a global community supporting your journey. Apply new skills directly to grow your idea.
